On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: The image many of us have of Japan is congested and kinetic. But Japan has a wild side. In winter, beyond its crowded cities, the country delivers quiet, unexpected natural beauty. In the second season opener, Art Wolfe ventures north to the remote region of Hokkaido to view iconic red-crested cranes; south to the mountains to take a dip in Nagano’s hot springs with mischievous macaque snow monkeys; and journeys on to the sacred temples of Mt. Fuji and Koyosan on a photographic pilgrimage.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: Australia’s Northern Territory is an immense, untamed wilderness as brutal as it is beautiful. For the Aboriginal people, it’s the place of the “Dreamtime”, where land and story meet. In episode two, Art Wolfe captures images of rock art intricately painted over thousands of years ago; discovers canyons carved by wind and water; and witnesses an ancient aboriginal dance as he chronicles the connection between the region’s first people and the natural world.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: It is a fabled land of sand, salt and nomads. But Mali is more than the Sahara; it is a place where the Niger River flows past some of Africa’s most unique tribal and architectural wonders. In episode three, Art Wolfe follows the river road to the camouflaged villages of the cliff-dwelling Dogon people; floats downriver to Djenne’s fantastic mud mosque; heads into the desert with nomadic Tuaregs; and finally travels on to Timbuktu where he meets up with a camel caravan.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: It is spring on the Antarctic Peninsula and the frozen wilderness is a veritable nursery for penguins, shore birds and seal pups. In episode four Art Wolfe crosses the infamous Drake Passage—the treacherous body of water south of Cape Horn—to explore the Falkland Islands and the Antarctic coast in search of wildlife and landscapes inherent to this pristine and unforgiving land.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: Located in the heart of South America, the Pantanal is the world’s largest wetland and home to one of the densest concentrations of wildlife on the planet. It’s a unique place where human activity and wildlife coexist. Here Brazilian cowboys ride herd alongside toothy caimans, giant otters, capybaras, macaws and toucans. In episode five, Art Wolfe arrives just as the seasonal floods have receded and discovers both an ecological paradise and a vibrant cowboy culture.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: West Africa is the birthplace of Voodoo; in Togo and Benin ancestors commingle with the living. Whether its vulture heads for sale at a fetish market or sacred bloodstained altars, Voodoo is always front and center. In episode six, Art Wolfe visits villages known for their vibrant inhabitants and intense rituals and discovers frenzied trances, powerful masked dances and an extraordinary fire-eating ceremony – all part of everyday life.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: New Zealand’s extreme beauty is central to its identity. Here indigenous Maori people see themselves as guardians of the land. In episode seven, Art Wolfe captures portraits of contemporary Maori artists who wear their stories on their faces in the form of sacred tattoos, and convey their sense of stewardship through their art. Then he heads off to the wild South Island to explore the natural history of this pristine and beautifully preserved island nation.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: Beyond India and Nepal’s crowded cities lie precious remnants of wild Asia where tigers, rhino and bear still roam. In episode eight, Art Wolfe travels by elephant deep into Kipling country in search of the last of the planet’s Bengal tigers. Here, through the lens of his camera, he captures images of mahouts—handlers bound to the elephants they’ve cared for from childhood—as they bathe and tend to their animals. In Nepal, Art encounters exotic wildlife including rare Asian rhinos, elusive sloth

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: Both an ocean oasis and isolated desert, the northern part of the narrow Baja peninsula is home to a surprising variety of plant and animal life. In episode nine, after a voyage on the Sea of Cortez in search of migrating gray whales, Art Wolfe ventures inland through the unforgiving Cataviña desert and discovers a photographer’s playground of light and magical landscapes.

programmes.t: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programmes.d: Known as the Land of the Thunder Dragon, Bhutan has survived in isolation for more than a thousand years. As this enlightened Buddhist kingdom greets the 21st century, its greatest challenge is to preserve its soul. In episode ten, Art Wolfe finds a photographer’s nirvana of mountainside monasteries, sacred festivals and chanting monks in an environmentally and spiritually progressive nation.
